description: A network of four hosts: a, b, r and c. Host a sends a TCP flow, fa, to c; host b sends a UDP flow, fb, to c at a constant rate ({fb.rate}, packets of {fb.packet_bytes} bytes). Both reach c through r, which forwards them. Link la joins a and r and link lb joins b and r; each carries {la.rate}. Link lc joins r and c and carries {lc.rate} with a one-way delay of {lc.delay}. On r's side of lc a scheduler divides the link between the two flows by two parts, {lc.queue.parts.fa} for fa and {lc.queue.parts.fb} for fb (the parts are divided by their sum); each flow waits in a queue of its own of {lc.queue.length} packets, and a packet that arrives at a full queue is dropped. The congestion control of fa is {fa.type}. In each simulation the flows start at 1 s of the simulation's clock, within 10 ms of each other; traffic runs for one second that is not measured, and then for duration seconds, over which the outputs are measured.

lc.queue.parts.fa.meaning: the part of link lc for flow fa (fb's part is fixed at 0.5; the parts are divided by their sum)

lc.queue.length.meaning: most packets each of the two queues of the scheduler holds

fa.type.meaning: TCP congestion control of flow fa
